[IDSP.1.1] **One adapter per verb.** Each action verb is
routed by the Rete action adapters
(`engine_rete_adapters.c`). At engine startup
`ds_engine_wire_rete_adapters` installs one `bridge_<verb>`
callback per verb into the engine's
`ds_rete_adapter_config_t` (via `ds_rete_register_adapters`);
when a rule's RHS fires verb `X`, the Rete evaluator invokes
`bridge_X`. The integrator-supplied callbacks themselves
live in the per-engine `ds_dispatcher_state_t` table
(`call_cb`, the
`cache_*_cb`s); each bridge reads the matching one and
invokes it.
